Reason for Mistake: The InformationExtraction_Expert made a mistake in calculating the number of years it took for the percentage to change by 13%. The expert correctly identified that the percentage of women in computer science decreased from 37% to 24%, resulting in a 13% change. However, the expert incorrectly calculated the time period as 30 years, from 1995 to 2025. The correct calculation should have been from 1995 to 2017 (when the percentage reached 24%), which is 22 years. The expert assumed the current year was 2025 instead of verifying the actual year when the percentage was 24%, leading to the incorrect conclusion of 30 years instead of the correct answer of 22 years.
